context:
Goal: banchi's waiting page shows its roadmap. Today the roadmap block is empty, while banchi's roadmap branch holds 146 steps.
Why you: banchi's page sits on another account, so no cloud session can rebuild it, and no session on your Mac is reachable from here (ListAgents, 23:16 CST: none). You only start the session; it does the work.
Steps: on your Mac, open a Claude Code session in the banchi checkout, or tell banchi's page writer if one runs. Paste the line below. Then press Done here.
Line to paste: Run skill waiting-page, step "Update the roadmap block", for banchi's waiting page.
title: Ask a Mac session to fill banchi's blank roadmap block
